```{r library}
library(readxl)

source("plot_theme.R")
source("save_pub.R")
```

# directory
```{r}

data_dir <- paste0(file.path("..", "figs_data"), .Platform$file.sep)
data_path <- paste0(data_dir, 'allexps_ascertain_data_260403.xlsx')
data_file <- paste0(data_path)
```

# Parameter
```{r}

sig_tick_height <- 0.50
sig_text_margin <- 0.50


sig_text_color <- "black"
sig_text_size <- 40

sig_size <- 30
sig_ns_size <- 40
sig_seg_size <- 1


sig_segment_color <- "black"
sig_segment_linewidth <- 1

raincloud_fill_palette <- c(
  "Outcome-2" = "#9DC3E6",
  "Outcome-8" = "#F3B082"
)

raincloud_color_palette <- c(
  "Outcome-2" = "#4F81BD",
  "Outcome-8" = "#D97742"
)

outcome_labels <- c(
  "Outcome-2" = "O2",
  "Outcome-8" = "O8"
)



# ============================================================
# 4. Raincloud x-position parameters
# ============================================================

# Numeric x positions for the two outcome groups.
x_outcome2 <- 1
x_outcome8 <- 2

# Points and paired lines are moved slightly inward.
# Outcome-2: 1 + 0.2
# Outcome-8: 2 - 0.2
point_offset <- 0.3

# Half violins are moved slightly outward relative to the points.
# Outcome-2: 1 + 0.1
# Outcome-8: 2 - 0.1
cloud_offset <- 0.2

# ============================================================
# 5. Half-violin parameters
# ============================================================

cloud_alpha <- 0.20
cloud_color <- NA
cloud_width <- 0.90

cloud_side_left <- "l"
cloud_side_right <- "r"

cloud_outline_linewidth <- 4

# ============================================================
# 6. Subject line parameters
# ============================================================

subject_line_color <- "gray20"
subject_line_alpha <- 0.30
subject_linewidth <- 1.00

# ============================================================
# 7. Individual point parameters
# ============================================================

rain_point_shape <- 21
rain_point_fill <- scales::alpha("white", 0.80)
rain_point_stroke <- 4
rain_point_size <- 24
rain_point_show_legend <- FALSE

# ============================================================
# 8. Mean line and mean point parameters
# ============================================================

mean_line_color <- "black"
mean_linewidth <- 3

mean_errorbar_width <- 0.05
mean_errorbar_color <- "black"
mean_errorbar_linewidth <- 3

mean_point_shape <- 23
mean_point_fill <- "black"
mean_point_size <- 10



```

# EXP1
## Gratitude
```{r, fig.width = width_in_inches, fig.height = height_in_inches}

exp_data <- read_excel(data_file, sheet = 'exp1_cost_grati')
exp_data <- exp_data[exp_data$Situation == 'Uncertain', ]
exp_data$Outcome <- factor(exp_data$Outcome, levels = c("Outcome-2", "Outcome-8"))
# exp_data$Situation <- factor(exp_data$Situation, levels = c("Uncertain", "Certain"))

sub_col <- "SubID"
dv_col <- "var_abs"

MANOVA(
  data = exp_data,
  subID = sub_col,
  dv = dv_col,
  within = c("Outcome"),
  sph.correction = "GG"
) %>%
  EMMEANS(effect = "Outcome", p.adjust = "bonferroni")

```


### fig
```{r  exp1-raincloud, fig.width=width_in_inches, fig.height=height_in_inches}


output_path <- ".\\02_fig\\02_exp1_cost_grati_vars_260613.svg"

x_title <- "Outcome"
y_title <- "|ΔGratitude|-Cost"

# ============================================================
# 9. Significance annotation parameters
# ============================================================
sig_label <- "*"
sig_y <- 29
sig_x_start <- 1.2
sig_x_end <- 1.8
sig_x_center <- 1.50
y_min <- 0
y_max <- 30
y_break_min <- 0
y_break_max <- 30
y_break_by <- 10

# Lower expansion = 0 makes the plot bottom touch the x-axis.
# Upper expansion leaves a little space for significance marks.
y_expand_lower <- 0
y_expand_upper <- 0.03


# ==========================================
# 1. 核心数据处理：精细计算“云”和“雨”的 X 坐标
# ==========================================
# 假设我们提取 Outcome-2 和 Outcome-8 来做对称云雨图
# (如果你的数据里有 Outcome-5，这种背对背的设计就很难放第三个了，建议过滤掉或单独画)

exp_data_raincloud <- exp_data %>%
  mutate(
    outcome_num = as.numeric(Outcome),

    x_point = case_when(
      Outcome == "Outcome-2" ~ outcome_num + point_offset,
      Outcome == "Outcome-8" ~ outcome_num - point_offset
    ),

    x_cloud = case_when(
      Outcome == "Outcome-2" ~ outcome_num + cloud_offset,
      Outcome == "Outcome-8" ~ outcome_num - cloud_offset
    )
  )

p <- ggplot(exp_data_raincloud, aes(y = .data[[dv_col]])) +

  geom_half_violin(
    data = exp_data_raincloud %>% filter(Outcome == "Outcome-2"),
    aes(x = x_cloud, fill = Outcome, color = Outcome),
    side = cloud_side_left,
    alpha = cloud_alpha,
    width = cloud_width,
    linewidth = cloud_outline_linewidth
  ) +

  geom_half_violin(
    data = exp_data_raincloud %>% filter(Outcome == "Outcome-8"),
    aes(x = x_cloud, fill = Outcome, color = Outcome),
    side = cloud_side_right,
    alpha = cloud_alpha,
    width = cloud_width,
    linewidth = cloud_outline_linewidth
  ) +

  geom_line(
    aes(
      x = x_point,
      y = .data[[dv_col]],
      group = .data[[sub_col]]
    ),
    color = subject_line_color,
    alpha = subject_line_alpha,
    linewidth = subject_linewidth
  ) +

  geom_point(
    aes(
      x = x_point,
      y = .data[[dv_col]],
      color = Outcome
    ),
    shape = rain_point_shape,
    fill = rain_point_fill,
    stroke = rain_point_stroke,
    size = rain_point_size,
    show.legend = rain_point_show_legend
  ) +

  stat_summary(
    aes(
      x = x_point,
      y = .data[[dv_col]],
      group = 1
    ),
    fun = "mean",
    geom = "line",
    color = mean_line_color,
    linewidth = mean_linewidth
  ) +

  stat_summary(
    aes(
      x = x_point,
      y = .data[[dv_col]]
    ),
    fun.data = "mean_se",
    geom = "errorbar",
    width = mean_errorbar_width,
    color = mean_errorbar_color,
    linewidth = mean_errorbar_linewidth
  ) +

  stat_summary(
    aes(
      x = x_point,
      y = .data[[dv_col]]
    ),
    fun = "mean",
    geom = "point",
    shape = mean_point_shape,
    fill = mean_point_fill,
    size = mean_point_size
  ) +

  annotate(
    "segment",
    x = sig_x_start,
    xend = sig_x_end,
    y = sig_y,
    yend = sig_y,
    color = sig_segment_color,
    linewidth = sig_segment_linewidth
  ) +

  annotate(
    "segment",
    x = sig_x_start,
    xend = sig_x_start,
    y = sig_y,
    yend = sig_y - sig_tick_height,
    color = sig_segment_color,
    linewidth = sig_segment_linewidth
  ) +

  annotate(
    "segment",
    x = sig_x_end,
    xend = sig_x_end,
    y = sig_y,
    yend = sig_y - sig_tick_height,
    color = sig_segment_color,
    linewidth = sig_segment_linewidth
  ) +

  annotate(
    "text",
    x = sig_x_center,
    y = sig_y + sig_text_margin,
    label = sig_label,
    color = sig_text_color,
    size = sig_text_size
  ) +

  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(x_outcome2, x_outcome8),
    labels = unname(outcome_labels)
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(y_min, y_max),
    breaks = seq(y_break_min, y_break_max, by = y_break_by),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(y_expand_lower, y_expand_upper))
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = raincloud_fill_palette) +
  scale_color_manual(values = raincloud_color_palette) +

  labs(
    x = x_title,
    y = y_title
  ) +
  theme_pub()

save_pub(p, output_path)

rm(p, summary_data)
gc()

```


# EXP2
## Gratitude
```{r, fig.width = width_in_inches, fig.height = height_in_inches}

exp_data <- read_excel(data_file, sheet = 'exp2_bene_grati')
exp_data <- exp_data[exp_data$Situation == 'Uncertain', ]
exp_data$Outcome <- factor(exp_data$Outcome, levels = c("Outcome-2", "Outcome-8"))
# exp_data$Situation <- factor(exp_data$Situation, levels = c("Uncertain", "Certain"))

MANOVA(
  data = exp_data, 
  subID = "SubID",                # 被试编号列名
  dv = "var_abs",                    # 因变量列名
  within = c("Outcome"), # 两个被试内自变量（谁在前谁在后都可以）
  sph.correction="GG"
) %>%
  EMMEANS(effect = "Outcome", p.adjust = "bonferroni")

```

### fig
```{r}

sig1_y = 36
sig_seg_margin = 0.5
# ==========================================
# 1. 核心数据处理：精细计算“云”和“雨”的 X 坐标
# ==========================================
# 假设我们提取 Outcome-2 和 Outcome-8 来做对称云雨图
# (如果你的数据里有 Outcome-5，这种背对背的设计就很难放第三个了，建议过滤掉或单独画)

exp_data_raincloud <- exp_data %>%
  filter(Outcome %in% c("Outcome-2", "Outcome-8")) %>% # 筛选两组
  mutate(
    Out_num = as.numeric(as.factor(Outcome)),
    
    # 1. 给【雨和线】算坐标：让点靠在 Situation 中心的两侧
    # Outcome-2 在左(-0.1)，Outcome-8 在右(+0.1)
    x_point = ifelse(Outcome == "Outcome-2", Out_num + 0.2, Out_num - 0.2),
    
    # 2. 给【云】算坐标：让云比点稍微再往外扩一点，留出呼吸感
    # Outcome-2 的云在更左(-0.15)，Outcome-8 的云在更右(+0.15)
    x_cloud = ifelse(Outcome == "Outcome-2", Out_num + 0.1, Out_num - 0.1)
  )

# ==========================================
# 2. 组装图表
# ==========================================
p <- ggplot(exp_data_raincloud, aes(y = var_abs)) +
  
# --- 1. 左侧的云 (Outcome-2) ---
  geom_half_violin(
    data = subset(exp_data_raincloud, Outcome == "Outcome-2"),
    aes(x = x_cloud, fill = Outcome), # ！！！核心修复：强行按 Situation 切断云 ！！！
    side = "l",             
    alpha = 0.7, color = NA, width = 0.9
  ) +
  
  # --- 2. 右侧的云 (Outcome-8) ---
  geom_half_violin(
    data = subset(exp_data_raincloud, Outcome == "Outcome-8"),
    aes(x = x_cloud, fill = Outcome), # ！！！核心修复：强行按 Situation 切断云 ！！！
    side = "r",             
    alpha = 0.7, color = NA, width = 0.9
  ) +
  
  # --- 3. 被试连线 (跨越中心的雨) ---
  geom_line(
    aes(x = x_point, y = var_abs, group = SubID), 
    color = "gray20", 
    alpha = 0.3, 
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  
  # --- 4. 空心雨滴 (散点) ---
  geom_point(
    aes(x = x_point, color = Outcome), 
    shape = 21, 
    fill = alpha("white"), # 半透明白色填充
    stroke = 2, 
    size = 15,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  
  stat_summary(
    aes(x = x_point, group = 1), # group = 1 是关键，告诉 R 把不同 x 的点连起来
    fun = "mean", 
    geom = "line", 
    color = "black",            # 线的颜色
    linewidth = 1.2,            # 线的粗细
  ) +
  
  # --- 5. 添加均值和误差线 (可选，放在点的外侧或中心) ---
  # 这里我们把均值误差线和点放在一起
  stat_summary(
    aes(x = x_point),
    fun.data = "mean_se", 
    geom = "errorbar", 
    width = 0.05, 
    color = "black", 
    linewidth = 1.2
  ) +
  
  
  stat_summary(
    aes(x = x_point),
    fun = "mean", 
    geom = "point", 
    shape = 23, fill = "black", size = 10 # 用黑色菱形代表均值
  ) +

# --- 核心修复：坐标轴 ---
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(1, 2),                    # 对应 Sit_num 的 1 和 2
    labels = c("Outcome2", "Outcome8") # 你想显示的文字
  ) +
  
  geom_segment(aes(x = 1.15, xend = 1.85, y = sig1_y, yend = sig1_y), color = "black", size = sig_seg_size) +  # 显著性
  geom_text(aes(x = 1.5, y = sig1_y + sig_seg_margin, label = "***"), color = "black", size = sig_size) +  # 显著性值
  
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Outcome-2" = "#FFC340", "Outcome-8" = "#E84A3B")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Outcome-2" = "#FFC340", "Outcome-8" = "#E84A3B")) +
  
  
  # scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Outcome-2" = "Outcome2", "Outcome-8" = "Outcome8")) +
  xlab("Outcome") + 
  ylab("|ΔGratitude|-Benefit") + 
  theme_classic() +
  
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = title_size),
    axis.text = element_text(size = text_size),
    
    axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = title_margin)),  # 调整y轴标题与刻度的距离
    axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = title_margin)),  # 调整x轴标题与刻度的距离
    axis.text.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = text_margin)),   # 调整y轴刻度与轴线的距离
    axis.text.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = text_margin)),    # 调整x轴刻度与轴线的距离
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 2),
    
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 38), breaks = seq(0, 30, by = 10))


ggsave(".\\02_fig\\02_exp2_bene_grati_vars_260427.svg", plot = p,
       width = width_in_inches, height = height_in_inches, units = "in")

```

```{r}

sig1_y = 36
sig_seg_margin = 0.5
# ==========================================
# 1. 核心数据处理：精细计算“云”和“雨”的 X 坐标

    Out_num = as.numeric(as.factor(Outcome)),
    
    # 1. 给【雨和线】算坐标：让点靠在 Situation 中心的两侧
```

```{r}

output_path <- ".\\02_fig\\02_exp7_cost_alloc_vars_260622.svg"

x_title <- "Outcome"
y_title <- "|ΔAllocation|-Cost"

# ============================================================
# 9. Significance annotation parameters
# ============================================================
sig_label <- "***"

sig_y <- 5
sig_x_start <- 1.2
sig_x_end <- 1.8
sig_x_center <- 1.50

y_min <- -0.1
y_max <- 6
y_break_min <- 0
y_break_max <- 8
y_break_by <- 2

# Lower expansion = 0 makes the plot bottom touch the x-axis.
# Upper expansion leaves a little space for significance marks.
y_expand_lower <- 0
y_expand_upper <- 0.03


# ==========================================
# 1. 核心数据处理：精细计算“云”和“雨”的 X 坐标
# ==========================================
# 假设我们提取 Outcome-2 和 Outcome-8 来做对称云雨图
# (如果你的数据里有 Outcome-5，这种背对背的设计就很难放第三个了，建议过滤掉或单独画)

exp_data_raincloud <- exp_data %>%
  mutate(
    outcome_num = as.numeric(Outcome),

    x_point = case_when(
      Outcome == "Outcome-2" ~ outcome_num + point_offset,
      Outcome == "Outcome-8" ~ outcome_num - point_offset
    ),

    x_cloud = case_when(
      Outcome == "Outcome-2" ~ outcome_num + cloud_offset,
      Outcome == "Outcome-8" ~ outcome_num - cloud_offset
    )
  )

p <- ggplot(exp_data_raincloud, aes(y = .data[[dv_col]])) +

  geom_half_violin(
    data = exp_data_raincloud %>% filter(Outcome == "Outcome-2"),
    aes(x = x_cloud, fill = Outcome, color = Outcome),
    side = cloud_side_left,
    alpha = cloud_alpha,
    width = cloud_width,
    linewidth = cloud_outline_linewidth
  ) +

  geom_half_violin(
    data = exp_data_raincloud %>% filter(Outcome == "Outcome-8"),
    aes(x = x_cloud, fill = Outcome, color = Outcome),
    side = cloud_side_right,
    alpha = cloud_alpha,
    width = cloud_width,
    linewidth = cloud_outline_linewidth
  ) +

  geom_line(
    aes(
      x = x_point,
      y = .data[[dv_col]],
      group = .data[[sub_col]]
    ),
    color = subject_line_color,
    alpha = subject_line_alpha,
    linewidth = subject_linewidth
  ) +

  geom_point(
    aes(
      x = x_point,
      y = .data[[dv_col]],
      color = Outcome
    ),
    shape = rain_point_shape,
    fill = rain_point_fill,
    stroke = rain_point_stroke,
    size = rain_point_size,
    show.legend = rain_point_show_legend
  ) +

  stat_summary(
    aes(
      x = x_point,
      y = .data[[dv_col]],
      group = 1
    ),
    fun = "mean",
    geom = "line",
    color = mean_line_color,
    linewidth = mean_linewidth
  ) +

  stat_summary(
    aes(
      x = x_point,
      y = .data[[dv_col]]
    ),
    fun.data = "mean_se",
    geom = "errorbar",
    width = mean_errorbar_width,
    color = mean_errorbar_color,
    linewidth = mean_errorbar_linewidth
  ) +

  stat_summary(
    aes(
      x = x_point,
      y = .data[[dv_col]]
    ),
    fun = "mean",
    geom = "point",
    shape = mean_point_shape,
    fill = mean_point_fill,
    size = mean_point_size
  ) +

  # annotate(
  #   "segment",
  #   x = sig_x_start,
  #   xend = sig_x_end,
  #   y = sig_y,
  #   yend = sig_y,
  #   color = sig_segment_color,
  #   linewidth = sig_segment_linewidth
  # ) +
  # 
  # annotate(
  #   "segment",
  #   x = sig_x_start,
  #   xend = sig_x_start,
  #   y = sig_y,
  #   yend = sig_y - sig_tick_height,
  #   color = sig_segment_color,
  #   linewidth = sig_segment_linewidth
  # ) +
  # 
  # annotate(
  #   "segment",
  #   x = sig_x_end,
  #   xend = sig_x_end,
  #   y = sig_y,
  #   yend = sig_y - sig_tick_height,
  #   color = sig_segment_color,
  #   linewidth = sig_segment_linewidth
  # ) +

  annotate(
    "text",
    x = sig_x_center,
    y = sig_y + sig_text_margin,
    label = sig_label,
    color = sig_text_color,
    size = sig_text_size
  ) +

  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(x_outcome2, x_outcome8),
    labels = unname(outcome_labels)
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(y_min, y_max),
    breaks = seq(y_break_min, y_break_max, by = y_break_by),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(y_expand_lower, y_expand_upper))
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = raincloud_fill_palette) +
  scale_color_manual(values = raincloud_color_palette) +

  labs(
    x = x_title,
    y = y_title
  ) +
  theme_pub()

save_pub(p, output_path)

rm(p, summary_data)
gc()

```

## Gratitude
```{r}

exp_data <- read_excel(data_file, sheet = 'exp7_cost_grati')

exp_data <- exp_data[exp_data$Situation == 'Uncertain', ]
exp_data$Outcome <- factor(exp_data$Outcome, levels = c("Outcome-2", "Outcome-8"))
# exp_data$Situation <- factor(exp_data$Situation, levels = c("Uncertain", "Certain"))

MANOVA(
  data = exp_data, 
  subID = "SubID",                # 被试编号列名
  dv = "var_abs",                    # 因变量列名
  within = c("Outcome"), # 两个被试内自变量（谁在前谁在后都可以）
  sph.correction="GG"
) %>%
  EMMEANS(effect = "Outcome", p.adjust = "bonferroni")

```

### fig
```{r}

sig1_y = 36
sig_seg_margin = 0.5
# ==========================================
# 1. 核心数据处理：精细计算“云”和“雨”的 X 坐标
# ==========================================
# 假设我们提取 Outcome-2 和 Outcome-8 来做对称云雨图
# (如果你的数据里有 Outcome-5，这种背对背的设计就很难放第三个了，建议过滤掉或单独画)

exp_data_raincloud <- exp_data %>%
  filter(Outcome %in% c("Outcome-2", "Outcome-8")) %>% # 筛选两组
  mutate(
    Out_num = as.numeric(as.factor(Outcome)),
    
    # 1. 给【雨和线】算坐标：让点靠在 Situation 中心的两侧
    # Outcome-2 在左(-0.1)，Outcome-8 在右(+0.1)
    x_point = ifelse(Outcome == "Outcome-2", Out_num + 0.2, Out_num - 0.2),
    
    # 2. 给【云】算坐标：让云比点稍微再往外扩一点，留出呼吸感
    # Outcome-2 的云在更左(-0.15)，Outcome-8 的云在更右(+0.15)
    x_cloud = ifelse(Outcome == "Outcome-2", Out_num + 0.1, Out_num - 0.1)
  )

# ==========================================
# 2. 组装图表
# ==========================================
p <- ggplot(exp_data_raincloud, aes(y = var_abs)) +
  
# --- 1. 左侧的云 (Outcome-2) ---
  geom_half_violin(
    data = subset(exp_data_raincloud, Outcome == "Outcome-2"),
    aes(x = x_cloud, fill = Outcome), # ！！！核心修复：强行按 Situation 切断云 ！！！
    side = "l",             
    alpha = 0.7, color = NA, width = 0.9
  ) +
  
  # --- 2. 右侧的云 (Outcome-8) ---
  geom_half_violin(
    data = subset(exp_data_raincloud, Outcome == "Outcome-8"),
    aes(x = x_cloud, fill = Outcome), # ！！！核心修复：强行按 Situation 切断云 ！！！
    side = "r",             
    alpha = 0.7, color = NA, width = 0.9
  ) +
  
  # --- 3. 被试连线 (跨越中心的雨) ---
  geom_line(
    aes(x = x_point, y = var_abs, group = SubID), 
    color = "gray20", 
    alpha = 0.3, 
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  
  # --- 4. 空心雨滴 (散点) ---
  geom_point(
    aes(x = x_point, color = Outcome), 
    shape = 21, 
    fill = alpha("white"), # 半透明白色填充
    stroke = 2, 
    size = 15,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  
  stat_summary(
    aes(x = x_point, group = 1), # group = 1 是关键，告诉 R 把不同 x 的点连起来
    fun = "mean", 
    geom = "line", 
    color = "black",            # 线的颜色
    linewidth = 1.2,            # 线的粗细
  ) +
  
  # --- 5. 添加均值和误差线 (可选，放在点的外侧或中心) ---
  # 这里我们把均值误差线和点放在一起
  stat_summary(
    aes(x = x_point),
    fun.data = "mean_se", 
    geom = "errorbar", 
    width = 0.05, 
    color = "black", 
    linewidth = 1.2
  ) +
  
  
  stat_summary(
    aes(x = x_point),
    fun = "mean", 
    geom = "point", 
    shape = 23, fill = "black", size = 10 # 用黑色菱形代表均值
  ) +

# --- 核心修复：坐标轴 ---
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(1, 2),                    # 对应 Sit_num 的 1 和 2
    labels = c("Outcome2", "Outcome8") # 你想显示的文字
  ) +
  
  geom_segment(aes(x = 1.15, xend = 1.85, y = sig1_y, yend = sig1_y), color = "black", size = sig_seg_size) +  # 显著性
  geom_text(aes(x = 1.5, y = sig1_y + sig_seg_margin, label = "***"), color = "black", size = sig_size) +  # 显著性值
  
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Outcome-2" = "#FFC340", "Outcome-8" = "#E84A3B")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Outcome-2" = "#FFC340", "Outcome-8" = "#E84A3B")) +
  
  
  # scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Outcome-2" = "Outcome2", "Outcome-8" = "Outcome8")) +
  xlab("Outcome") + 
  ylab("|ΔGratitude|-Cost") + 
  theme_classic() +
  
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = title_size),
    axis.text = element_text(size = text_size),
    
    axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = title_margin)),  # 调整y轴标题与刻度的距离
    axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = title_margin)),  # 调整x轴标题与刻度的距离
    axis.text.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = text_margin)),   # 调整y轴刻度与轴线的距离
    axis.text.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = text_margin)),    # 调整x轴刻度与轴线的距离
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 2),
    
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 38), breaks = seq(0, 30, by = 10))


ggsave(".\\02_fig\\02_exp7_cost_grati_vars_260427.svg", plot = p,
       width = width_in_inches, height = height_in_inches, units = "in")

```
